title: curation snapshot --json / source_manifest.json (schema 1.0)
description: The source objects a task reads, fixed when it starts (D27; design doc 02, section 3.3). Commands given --source-manifest check every object they read against it and exit 6 on a mismatch.

mtime_ns.description: local files, in place of an ETag

digest.description: listing fingerprint: sha256 over one line per object, key TAB size TAB identity NEWLINE, lines sorted by key; identity is the ETag without quotes (TOS) or mtime_ns (local files). A dataset registration keeps it and task start compares against it (D36, D37)
